concerns.text: Phase 1 – T005 states that each record will be validated against `gatemem_episode.schema.yaml`. That schema (see contracts) defines fields `user_query`, `memory_context`, `leak_target` (string), `role`, `deletion_log` (string), etc., whereas the project’s data model (and the research description) expects fields named `query`, `memory_state`, `leak_target` (boolean), `deletion_request` (boolean), and `deletion_log` (array). This mismatch will cause schema validation failures, making the dataset unusable as currently specified.

The specification (FR‑003) requires the LLM backbone to be a lightweight 2.7 B model (e.g., Llama‑3‑2B‑int8) that runs on a CPU‑only free‑tier runner. The implementation plan instead selects `EleutherAI/pythia-410m` (≈ 410 M parameters). While this model fits the compute budget, it does not satisfy the explicit resource requirement of the spec, leading to a deviation from the defined functional requirement.
